description: This file defines the 'OpenClawConfigFile' enum containing static methods and properties for managing configuration settings, reading/writing configuration data, handling configuration health states, and performing security audits within an OpenClaw-based application. It includes functions for URL management, JSON serialization, file metadata, and suspicious activity detection.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL for the configuration file location.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration dictionary from disk. Returns an empty dictionary if the file does not exist or parsing fails.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Serializes and saves a configuration dictionary to disk, with auditing and suspicious activity detection.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Loads only the 'gateway' section of the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Modifies the 'gateway' section of the configuration and saves it back to disk.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether browser control is enabled, based on configuration.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets the browser control enabled flag in configuration and saves.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the agent workspace setting from configuration.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the agent workspace in configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway password from configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway port number from configuration.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port number from the remote gateway URL.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL in configuration using host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Computes a normalized key for a given host string for comparison purposes.
